text:
incident-bot: PAGER: GPU capacity exhaustion in prod-east detected. Autoscaler failing to attach new GPU nodes. Queue length > 1200. Paging oncall.

oncall-ops: I'm up, looking. Any affected customer calls out?

sam: Observed 503s on /v1/generate for embeddings workloads. Error rate 8% over the last 3m. Token throughput dropped 40%.

mira: Grafana shows rapid queue growth on gpu-inference-queue between 12:03:05 and 12:05:20. Autoscaler events show several failed AttachRole calls to Instance Profile.

luis: logs from the autoscaler:```ERROR 12:04:11 attachrole failed: RequestLimitExceeded: Rate exceeded when calling the AttachRolePolicy operation``` then ```WARN 12:04:12 nodegroup create timed out after 2m```

devin: Looks like IAM attachrole backoff hit, but we also have launch template mismatch warnings that cause nodes to be rejected on join. Getting: ```kubelet: node rejected due to taint mismatch: gpu=reserved:NoSchedule```

cathy: Customer impact: several mid-size customers running realtime chat embeddings reported timeouts. CS flagged 3 paying customers on slack: @acme, @novus, @starlab. Not yet escalated externally.

oncall-ops: Confirming: autoscaler tried 6 times to create instances in nodegroup gpu-pool-prod-east, all failed. ASG shows instances in Pending:Provisioning for >5m. EC2 shows InstanceProfile error 401 on metadata when kubelet tried to fetch credentials.

mira: Dumping recent cloud events -> ```CreateFleet: success, AttachRoleToInstanceProfile: throttled, RunInstances: success, InstanceProfileAssociation: failed (RequestLimitExceeded)```

luis: Quick mitigation idea: manually attach a warmed nodegroup with pre-associated instance profile using the backup nodegroup 'gpu-prewarm-east' and add to cluster, then cordon older pools to drain backlog.

oncall-ops: Can we do that without triggering more IAM calls? The prewarm group already exists but it's at min-size 0 in this region. Scaling it up will still call RunInstances but won't need AttachRole if instance profile baked in.
devin: I'll kick a manual scale to gpu-prewarm-east to +6 instances, request id r-attachman-01. Command: ```rctl nodegroup scale --name gpu-prewarm-east --replicas 6 --region prod-east --reason "pager mitigation"```
cathy: Patch note for CS: telling affected customers we are actively mitigating, ETA ~15-30m. No data loss, degraded latencies and some 503s.

(infra-bot): deploy-bot: triggered scale job r-attachman-01 by oncall-ops. Job queued.

oncall-ops: Started manual scale at 12:07:08. Watching ASG and kube join logs.

sam: I can temporarily enable graceful fallback to smaller model for embeddings route to reduce token load: feature flag ff-lite-embeddings -> ON. Would reduce cost but slightly lower vector quality. Need approval?
mira: Do it. We need immediate throughput relief. Sam flip it.
sam: flipped ff-lite-embeddings at 12:08:30. Monitor impact.

luis: ASG instances changed to InService at 12:10:02, but kube nodes still not Ready due to kubelet credentials fetch failing with IMDS v2 enforced token not present in the baked image. Log snippet: ```failed to retrieve role credentials: no token found; metadata service returned 401```
devin: Oh—some images prewarm used older cloud-init not requesting IMDSv2 token. Newer instance profile function requires explicit token. We can manually set kubelet to use node join bootstrap token temporarily. Suggest: add label allow-bootstrapped=true and accept nodes, then rotate to proper IAM fix later.
oncall-ops: That's risky but lowers customer impact. What's the blast radius?
luis: only nodes in gpu-prewarm-east with tag prewarm=true. We can accept them and schedule pods immediately. No cross-tenant secrets on node.
oncall-ops: Proceed. I'll approve manual acceptance.

(infra-bot): iam-batch: temporary-policy-allow-attach applied to oncall-ops for 20m window.
oncall-ops: Accepting nodes now and uncordoning, forcing kubelet bootstrap path.
mira: Pods starting to bind to new nodes, queue dropping from 1200 -> 360 within 4m. 503s per minute dropped from 8% -> 0.7%.
cathy: CS update: told customers mitigation in progress, some requests may still see degraded latency. No SLA breach yet.
sam: Reverted fallback model flag at 12:18:50? Wait, keep it on until we confirm stability for 30m.
oncall-ops: Agreed keep fallback for 30m. Also opening ticket to fix launch template vs baked image IMDS v2 mismatch and to increase AttachRole API quota or implement jittered backoff in autoscaler.
devin: Filing follow-up: incident-3955554321 on internal tracker, priority P2. Action items: (1) bake IMDSv2 token into image, (2) add attachrole exponential backoff and metrics, (3) add prewarm replica policy for peak hours, (4) CS post-incident note.
mira: Last check 12:19:30: queue at 220, token throughput at 92% of baseline. I'll keep monitoring and handoff at 12:40 to next oncall.
oncall-ops: Handoff to night-sre at 12:40. If any re-escalation, ping oncall-sre@pager. :thumbsup:
